data.content_ref: inline:The four complement-style derivations (SRC_002, SRC_003, SRC_001, and the per-hundred-block sum) all reduce to the positional product 9 × 9 × 8 = 648 by reorganizing the same partition of digit-tuples: the complement union {A_h=t ∪ A_t=u ∪ A_h=u} and the direct-construction cases (zero-present vs zero-absent) are dual descriptions of the same 252-element residual. This is refuted if a tuple counted as belonging to the complement in one method is counted as distinct in another, i.e. if the partition boundaries cross (a number simultaneously satisfies 'has a repeated digit' and 'has all digits distinct' under the two schemes).
